description: Benchmark cases for AI reasoning engine evaluation. Each case has clinical data and an expected decision outcome.

cases.label: CGM clearly meets all criteria
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 52-year-old female with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus diagnosed 4 years ago. Current HbA1c: 9.2%. Currently on basal-bolus insulin regimen (Lantus 30 units QHS + Humalog sliding scale). Frequent hypoglycemic episodes requiring emergency visits (3 in past 6 months). Endocrinologist recommends CGM to improve glycemic control and reduce hypoglycemia risk. Patient is motivated and willing to use the device.

cases.label: CGM requested for pre-diabetes, not covered
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 38-year-old male with pre-diabetes (ICD-10: R73.09). HbA1c: 6.3%. Not on insulin or any diabetes medications. No documented hypoglycemic episodes. Primary care physician requests CGM for 'better glucose tracking'. Patient not diagnosed with Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes.

policy_criteria.evidence: Pre-diabetes, not Type 1 or Type 2 DM

cases.denial_reason: CGM not covered for pre-diabetes. Policy requires Type 1 or Type 2 diabetes diagnosis with HbA1c > 7.0% and insulin therapy.

cases.label: Knee replacement - missing physical therapy documentation
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 67-year-old male requesting total knee replacement for right knee osteoarthritis. X-rays show KL Grade 3 changes. Patient reports significant pain and functional limitation. However, no formal physical therapy records included in submission. Surgeon's note mentions 'patient tried conservative treatment' without specific documentation.

cases.label: MRI brain for MS monitoring - clearly appropriate
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 34-year-old female with established diagnosis of relapsing-remitting multiple sclerosis (RRMS) diagnosed 2 years ago. Currently on Ocrelizumab. Neurologist requests annual brain MRI to monitor disease progression. Last MRI was 14 months ago (exceeds 12-month monitoring interval). No new symptoms but routine monitoring indicated per MS Society guidelines.

policy_criteria.evidence: 14 months since last MRI > 12 month minimum

cases.label: Biologic requested without DMARD failure
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 45-year-old female with rheumatoid arthritis (seropositive). Rheumatologist requests adalimumab as first-line therapy. No prior DMARD therapy documented. Disease Activity Score (DAS28) = 4.2 (moderate). Patient prefers to start with a biologic rather than conventional therapy.
cases.denial_reason: Step therapy required. Must demonstrate failure or intolerance to at least one conventional DMARD before biologic therapy.

cases.label: CPAP for moderate OSA with daytime symptoms
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 51-year-old male with documented obstructive sleep apnea. Polysomnography report: AHI = 22 events/hour (moderate OSA). Symptoms include excessive daytime sleepiness (Epworth score 14/24), non-restorative sleep, and morning headaches. Sleep specialist recommends CPAP therapy.

cases.label: Spinal cord stimulator - contradictory clinical evidence
cases.clinical_notes: Patient is a 58-year-old male with failed back surgery syndrome and chronic low back pain for 8 years. Pain management physician recommends spinal cord stimulator implant. Previous trial stimulator showed 60% pain reduction (meets >50% threshold). However, psychiatric evaluation notes active major depressive disorder and opioid use disorder in partial remission. Social history indicates multiple prior authorizations denied by other insurers. Complex case with conflicting factors.
